create_gtn_graph: create a gtn Graph object with an initial node for building a finite state transducer
add_node_to_graph: add a node to a gtn graph with optional initial and final state flags
add_arc_to_graph: add an arc between two nodes in a gtn graph with a symbol label
draw_graph_to_pdf: draw a gtn graph to a PDF file with input and output symbol mappings
union_gtn_graphs: compute the union of multiple gtn graphs into a single combined graph
